rows.label: tlk43700143_04_msg0002
rows.name:
You're not just carrying on
Vandham-danna's will. You've gone far
beyond it...

rows.label: tlk43700143_04_msg0003
rows.name:
Even the mercs from our lot are
starting to want to join them.

rows.label: tlk43700143_04_msg0004
rows.name:
I'm joking, so relax. You don't want
more scary, muscular old men around,
do you?

rows.label: tlk43700143_04_msg0005
rows.name:
It'd be like having ten
Vandham-dannas around.
